_instructions.authors: Add authors in publication order. Each author needs name, affiliation_ids, corresponding (true/false), and email only for the one corresponding author.
_instructions.affiliations: Map string IDs such as 1 and 2 to complete department/institution/city/state-or-province/country strings.
_instructions.present_addresses: Use [] if none; otherwise list complete present-address strings.
_instructions.funding_acknowledgments: Enter confirmed funding/grant text, or an explicit no-external-funding statement if true.
_instructions.additional_acknowledgments: Optional additional acknowledgments; use an empty string if none after confirmation.
_instructions.author_contributions: Enter an all-author-approved CRediT-style contribution statement.
_instructions.conflict_of_interest: Enter an all-author-confirmed competing-interests statement; do not assume none.
_instructions.ai_tool_inventory_confirmed: Set true only after confirming the complete AI-tool inventory.
_instructions.additional_ai_tools: List AI tools beyond OpenAI ChatGPT, or [] only after inventory confirmation.
_instructions.dual_publication_statement: Enter the author-confirmed overlap/dual-publication statement for the submission form.
_instructions.permanent_archive_doi: Optional for initial submission; add the permanent data/code archive DOI when available.
_instructions.privacy: Copy this template to an untracked local file before filling personal contact metadata. Do not commit completed author/contact metadata unless every author explicitly agrees.
